◆ search_path_affiliated_ap()

std::string beerocks::wbapi::wbapi_utils::search_path_affiliated_ap ( const std::string &  apmld,
const std::string &  mac 
)
static

Return search path of AffiliatedAP object instance filtered by BSSID.

Constructs and returns the search path for an AffiliatedAP instance within an APMLD object, filtered by BSSID (MAC address). The function handles both lowercase and uppercase MAC address formats to ensure reliable path resolution regardless of MAC address case in the data model.

Parameters
[in]apmldThe APMLD object path (e.g., from search_path_apmld_by_mldid()).
[in]macThe BSSID (MAC address) to filter by.
Returns
Search path string for the AffiliatedAP instance (e.g., "WiFi.APMLD.1.AffiliatedAP.[BSSID == 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff' || BSSID == 'AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF'].")
